about.experience: The timeline in the Experience section, in this order.
about.projects: The project cards. A placeholder reserves a card until its write-up is ready.
about.skill-groups: The groups of chips in the Skills section.
about.education: Education, under Credentials in the Skills section.
about.certifications: Certifications, under Credentials in the Skills section.
about.languages: Spoken languages, under Credentials in the Skills section.
about.contact-links: The direct channels at the top of the Contact section.
about.site-texts: Single lines of text used around the site. They can be edited, but not added or removed.

editor.missingBody: There is no entry “{{slug}}” in this collection. It may have been deleted.
editor.savedNewer: Saved “{{title}}”. You have newer changes that are not saved yet.
editor.notSaved: Not saved. Please check the highlighted fields.
editor.fieldRejected: The server rejected a field that this form does not show:
editor.bodyRejected: The server rejected the entry as a whole. Please check that the fields agree with each other.
editor.gone: This entry no longer exists; it may have been deleted in another tab. Go back to the list to continue.
editor.changedElsewhere: This entry was changed elsewhere since you opened it. Reload it to see the latest version; your changes are kept in this tab until you leave.
editor.loadLatestBody: The form will show the version saved elsewhere, and your unsaved changes on this page will be discarded. This cannot be undone.
editor.loadLatestFailed: The latest version could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
editor.latestLoaded: The latest version is shown. Your changes were discarded.
editor.tooLarge: This entry is too large to save. Please shorten it.
editor.saveFailed: The server could not save the entry. Try again in a moment.
editor.saveFailedNetwork: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again; your changes are still here.
editor.restored: Your unsaved changes from before have been restored.
editor.restoredStale: Your unsaved changes from before have been restored, but this entry has been saved elsewhere since then. Check every field before saving, or discard them.
editor.restoredDiscarded: Restored changes discarded: the saved version is shown.

hints.slug: The entry's id in the site's code. A lower-case letter first, then letters, digits, - or _ (up to 64 characters). It cannot be changed later.
hints.slugSuggested: The entry's id in the site's code, suggested from the English name. A lower-case letter first, then letters, digits, - or _ (up to 64 characters). It cannot be changed later.
hints.slugFixed: The id cannot be changed once the entry exists.
hints.tags: Proper nouns such as React or Microsoft Azure appear as typed in both languages. Tick “Translated term” for descriptive chips such as Data pipelines, and give both versions.
hints.bullets: Each bullet in English and Traditional Chinese; {{min}} to {{max}} bullets.
hints.placeholder: Reserves a card on the site until the write-up is ready: no title, summary, link, technologies or image.
hints.projectUrl: A public web address, preferably https://. Leave it empty when there is nothing to link to.
hints.href: mailto:name@example.com for an email address, or a web address (preferably https://).
hints.display: The text visitors see, such as the address without https://.
hints.siteText: Shown on the site as written, in each language.

errors.tooLong: Please keep this to {{max}} characters or fewer.

image.title: Cover image
image.intro: Shown on the project card. JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 8 MB; the server resizes it. Changes here are saved at once, separately from the form above.
image.saveFirst: Create the project first, then add its cover image here.
image.placeholderNote: Save this project as a real project (untick “Placeholder slot”) to add a cover image.
image.uploadFailed: The cover image was not saved.
image.removeBody: The card goes back to its plain frame. This cannot be undone.
